About_&_Key_Points:
About
Laxmi Goldorna House Ltd is an Ahmedabad-
focused residential and commercial developer
and wholesale/retail trader of BIS-hallmarked
gold and studded jewellery. Jewellery designing
and processing are outsourced to job workers;
it has no owned manufacturing plant.
Key Points
Business model:
[1]
LGHL was incorporated in 2010 for the jewellery business and added real estate in 2017. Jewellery includes traditional, modern and Indo-Western gold ornaments, with/without precious and semi-precious stones, sold wholesale and retail across price points. Designing/processing is outsourced; hence economics depend on trading spreads, inventory turns and gold prices. Real estate develops and sells residential/commercial units in Ahmedabad.
